diagnosis: C8 does not enforce the acceptance condition requiring a commitment for the 75-basis-point pricing step-up. A settlement can therefore pass every check while omitting that required commitment.
evidence: C8 checks only prepayment and monthly-certificate commitment details; it has no pricing-step-up commitment test.
fix_instructions: Extend C8 with an additional any(...) clause requiring a commitment detail that specifies the 75-basis-point pricing step-up, or add a separate content check for that commitment.
